text: Thirumathy Homemade Protein Coffee 100GM RS 80
Thirumathy Homemade Protein Coffee is a caffeine-free, natural energy drink alternative packaged in a 100g net weight pouch.
How to Use:
Add 2 teaspoons (10–15 g) of Protein Coffee powder to a cup.
Pour 150–200 ml of hot milk (or hot water if preferred).
Stir well until completely dissolved.
Add jaggery, palm sugar, or sugar to taste (optional).
Drink once or twice daily, preferably in the morning or evening.
Serving Suggestion for the Label:
How to Use
Mix 2 tsp (10–15 g) in 150–200 ml hot milk or hot water.
Stir well.
Sweeten as desired.
Serve hot.
Thirumathy Multi Traditional Rice Puttu (250 g) RS 100
How to Use
Take 1 cup (100 g) of Puttu Mix in a bowl.
Add 2 cups (400 ml) of water gradually while stirring to avoid lumps.
Cook on medium flame for 5–7 minutes, stirring continuously until soft and thick.
Serve hot with grated coconut, banana, jaggery, sugar, or curry as desired.
Cooking Ratio:1 Cup Puttu Mix : 2 Cups Water

Note: If this product is truly an instant "No Steaming • Ready to Eat" mix, then the current instruction on the package ("2 cup water to 1 cup puttu") may be misleading. If it only needs mixing with hot water and no cooking, let me know the exact product type, and I can provide the correct instructions for the label.

Nutri Fruit Malt100g 110rs
Nutri Fruit Malt appears to be a health drink mix. A simple way to use it is:
How to Use
Take 2–3 tablespoons (20–25 g) of Nutri Fruit Malt.
Add it to 200 ml of milk (hot or cold) or warm water.
Stir or shake well until fully dissolved.
Add jaggery, honey, or sugar if you prefer it sweeter (optional).
Drink once or twice a day, preferably:
In the morning with breakfast, or
In the evening as a healthy snack.
For children, use 1–2 tablespoons mixed with 150–200 ml of milk.
Thirumathy Weight Loss Kanji Mix     100g  70rs
here is a simple way to use it:
Add 2–3 tablespoons (25–30 g) of Kanji Mix to 250–300 ml of water.
Stir well so there are no lumps.
Cook on medium flame for 5–10 minutes, stirring continuously until it becomes a smooth porridge.
Add salt (for a savory version) or jaggery/palm jaggery (for a sweet version), according to your taste.
Serve warm.
For weight management:
Drink 1 bowl as breakfast or replace dinner with it.
Avoid adding sugar.
Pair it with a balanced diet and regular exercise.
Drink plenty of water throughout the day.
Thirumathy Dates Powder 100 g 100rs
here's how to use it:
How to use Dates Powder
Option 1: With milk (most common)
Add 1–2 teaspoons (5–10 g) of dates powder to 1 cup (200 ml) of warm milk.
Stir well and drink.
Since it is a natural sweetener, you usually don't need to add sugar.
Option 2: With warm water
Mix 1–2 teaspoons in 1 cup of warm water and stir well.
Option 3: In foodsYou can also add it to:
Porridge or kanji
Oats
Ragi malt
Smoothies and milkshakes
Yogurt/curd
Homemade sweets and dessert
